segments.text: Stop doom scrolling through 100page SEC filings. This is Tank. Talk to 10Ks and 10 Q's with AI. Instead of reading
filings line by line, you just ask questions in plain English. And Tank answers with real citations linked straight to the source. No
hallucinations, no guessing. It autofetches filings from the SEC, indexes them locally with RAG, and lets you query across multiple reports instantly.
